author: ojiudezue
title: v5.95.1 shipped: Face-producer health gate self-heals the boot race
summary: Face-producer health gate self-heals the boot race
why: The v5.95.0 fail-safe health gate resolved sensor.frigate_status_2 via the registry once and cached the result unconditionally, including when it resolved to None. At boot, URA's first census tick can run before frigate_status_2 has a state (observed live: a 21s lag), so it cached None for the whole session and reported frigate_status_missing_configured (fail-closed) forever, suppressing face even with Frigate running. It failed safe but left the just-shipped corroboration feature inert until a lucky restart. The fix only latches the cache on a successful resolve and re-checks each tick while unresolved, so it self-heals the moment Frigate appears.
implications: Shipped IDENTITY-FACE-HEALTH-BOOTCACHE-1 at v5.95.1; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.95.1.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Post-restart: face_producer_health reads live (not frigate_status_missing_configured) once Frigate is up and past the first census tick

refs.release_notes: The face fail-safe health gate cached a failed Frigate-status lookup permanently when Frigate lagged URA at boot, leaving face corroboration suppressed all session (fail-safe direction). Now re-resolves each census tick until the status entity appears, then self-heals to live. 2 framing-disjoint reviews + orchestrator mutation-verify.
